steps.title: Step 1: Open X Developer Portal
steps.desc: Go to developer.x.com and log in. Click on 'Products' and select 'Twitter API v2' (Free or Basic tier is perfect).

steps.title: Step 2: Create a Project
steps.desc: Click 'Create Project' and give it a name like 'Pintopay Studio'. Then create an 'App' inside the project.

steps.title: Step 3: App Permissions
steps.desc: Go to App Settings > User Authentication. Select 'OAuth 1.0a'. Change permissions from 'Read Only' to 'Read and Write'. For Website/Callback URL, just use: https://t.me/pintopay_probot

steps.title: Step 4: Get Your 4 Keys
steps.desc: Go to 'Keys and Tokens' tab. Regenerate 'Consumer Keys' and 'Access Tokens'. Copy all 4 codes: API Key, API Secret, Access Token, and Access Secret.

steps.title: Step 5: Link to P2PHub
steps.desc: Paste these 4 codes in the API Setup window here and click 'SAVE SETTINGS'. You're now ready to broadcast to X!

steps.title: Step 6: Limitless Content (Pro Tip)
steps.desc: X limits 'Free' accounts to very short posts. To publish powerful long-form AI insights (300+ chars), we strongly recommend X Premium. This also unlocks the 'Basic' API tier, ensuring maximum performance for your viral machine.

steps.title: Step 1: Create a channel
steps.desc: Click 'New Channel' in Telegram. Give it a bold name and upload an avatar.

steps.title: Step 2: Add Assistant Bot
steps.desc: Go to Channel Settings > Administrators > Add Admin. Search for @{{bot_username}} and add it.

steps.title: Step 3: Grant Permissions
steps.desc: When adding the bot, ensure 'Post Messages' is enabled. This allows the bot to broadcast your content.

steps.title: Step 4: Link to P2PHub
steps.desc: Copy your channel's public link (e.g., @mycoolchannel) and paste it into the API Setup window here. Save and you're set!
